svg.title: macOS · Settings · Libraries · Move library? (sheet) · 760×680
svg.desc: Mirrors StorageLocationSheet in its .move mode (App/SettingsView.swift, raised by Move This Library…) over StorageMover (App/StorageLocation.swift) — the copy-never-delete mover of 2026-08-25, retitled for the Libraries card 2026-09-16 (captured 2026-09-18 with LL_TAB=settings LL_STORAGE=move; the hook's demo destination and size are /Volumes/Demo Drive/LetsLapse and 12,4 GB since 2026-09-18 — they had been a real-looking drive and 148 GB, which alarmed a person watching a bench run). 'Move library?' with the destination under it, prose 'Your library — about 12,4 GB of projects, thumbnails and capture logs — is copied to this folder, and LetsLapse relaunches to use it there. Nothing is deleted: the current copy stays at <current path> until you remove it yourself in Finder.' — Move Library (primary) · Cancel. The move carries StorageRoot.libraryItemNames only, checks free space against the walked total first, and on success commits the path and flips to the Relaunch screen; the progress variant is settings-libraries.moving.svg.
